title: Restore Verification — Pre-Live Checks

lines.text: Clinical Engineering, CNO, this is ISO-01. Clean-room build under way. Before any system returns to patient care, I need three verification checks: allergy and high-alert medication data must match the BCA-VIEW01 packets; pump drug libraries must be unchanged; and barcode scanning must work at two bedside units. I am not letting a restored EHR go live on a promise. Who owns each check?
Understood, ISO. Clinical Engineering will validate the pump drug libraries and confirm no changes since 05:15 on BCA-VIEW01. I will report back by 09:15.
Copy, ISO. The CNO will personally test barcode scanning on two units—4 West and ICU 3 North—before any go-live. I will confirm with you by 09:20.
Good. I will monitor restored hosts for 72 hours post-launch. The AOC will log that a restore is not an all-clear. We are not done until we are certain.

fields.voiceStyle: Middle-aged male, calm but urgent, slightly out of breath

instructorNote: This inject confirms the ISO's authority to delay go-live despite system restoration. Watch for the CNO to assign the barcode test, the CE to claim the pump library check, and the ISO to enforce verification. Do not accept a single check as complete.
